body: Root-caused 2026-09-24 (55979e7): after `agx sessions promote`, `agx resume` in the promoted folder found nothing while `claude -c` worked, because agx matched the transcript's recorded cwd (stale after the rename). Fix: folder lookups trust HistoryDir like Claude Code does (see rul_01a147bb887b7a64859bc37a2f5c3332). Verified live: `claude -c` in a promoted folder recalled a word from before the move.
